title.zh: 选型逻辑：从结构需求倒推路线
title.en: Selection logic: work backward from structural requirements

subtitle.zh: 材料兼容、目标形貌、损伤预算与总成本。
subtitle.en: Material compatibility, target profile, damage budget and total cost

body.zh: 核心判断：先看技术要求能否满足，再比较整段工艺的成本、产能和稳定性。
body.en: Core assessment: meet technical requirements first, then compare total-flow cost, throughput and stability

body.zh: 流程位置：用于工艺整合与路线评估，；决定采用干法、湿法或两者串联。
body.en: Position in the flow: process integration and route evaluation to choose dry, wet or a combination

body.zh: 决策流程：列材料堆栈 → 定目标形状与去除量 →；查选择比和损伤限制 → 比较后处理与量产条件 →；用代表性结构验证。
body.en: Decision flow: list the material stack → define target shape and removal amount → check selectivity and damage limits → compare post-treatment and production conditions → validate representative structures

body.zh: 关键约束：目标形貌/尺寸、保护层损失预算、；表面及结构耐受性、整段成本与产能。
body.en: Key constraints: target profile/dimensions, protective-layer loss budget, surface and structural tolerance, total-flow cost and throughput

body.zh: 耦合与失效：湿法批量处理可能有吞吐优势，仍需计入；药液、漂洗干燥和材料损失；干法也需计入设备、耗材、；维护与后处理。仅按单步时间选择，可能遗漏结构塌陷、；残膜或下游性能劣化。
body.en: Coupling and failure: batch wet processing may offer throughput advantages, but include chemicals, rinse/dry and material loss; dry processing must include equipment, consumables, maintenance and post-treatment; selecting only by single-step time may miss structural collapse, residual film or downstream performance degradation

body.zh: 场景判断：；细线图形、深孔、；陡直侧壁：；通常优先评估；方向性干法。；方向性干法；（陡直侧壁）
body.en: Scenario assessment Fine patterns, deep holes and steep sidewalls: usually evaluate directional dry etching first Directional dry etch (steep sidewalls)

body.zh: 去除特定暴露膜层：；可评估选择性湿法，；同时核对所有暴露材料。；选择性湿法；（去除特定膜层）
body.en: Remove specific exposed films: evaluate selective wet etching while checking all exposed materials Selective wet etch (remove a specific film)

body.zh: 利用单晶硅晶面成形：；可评估KOH等晶面；选择性湿法。；晶面选择性湿法；（如KOH，斜侧壁）
body.en: Shape single-crystal silicon by crystal planes: evaluate KOH and other crystal-plane-selective wet methods Crystal-plane-selective wet etch (e.g. KOH, sloped sidewalls)

body.zh: 脆弱结构释放：；结合材料选择性与干燥风险，；评估湿法配合适配干燥，；或气相释放。；湿法配合适配干燥；或气相释放（如XeF₂）
body.en: Release fragile structures: combine material selectivity with drying risk; evaluate wet release with suitable drying or vapor-phase release Wet release with suitable drying or vapor-phase release (e.g. XeF₂)
2 Define target shape and removal amount

body.zh: 典型串联示例：干法定义结构 → 适配湿法去膜/清洗；1.干法定义结构；（如刻蚀形成图形）；2.适配湿法去膜/清洗；（清洗与刻蚀目的不同，；也可能改变材料厚度）
body.en: Typical combined route: dry structural definition → compatible wet stripping/cleaning 1. Define structure by dry etching (e.g. etch a pattern) 2. Compatible wet stripping/cleaning (cleaning and etching serve different purposes, and cleaning may also change film thickness)

body.zh: 量测反馈；比较代表性结构的形貌、；材料损失、缺陷、电性和；批间稳定性，据此确认路线。
body.en: Metrology feedback Compare representative profiles, material loss, defects, electrical properties and lot-to-lot stability to confirm the route

body.zh: 形貌；材料损失；缺陷；电性；批间稳定性；反馈优化
body.en: Profile Material loss Defects Electrical properties Lot-to-lot stability Feedback optimization

body.zh: 下游影响与边界：；可按需要串联“干法定义；结构 → 适配湿法去膜/清洗”，；但清洗与刻蚀目的不同，；也可能改变材料厚度。；节点名称和“干/湿”标签；都不足以单独完成选型。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries Combine dry structural definition with suitable wet stripping/cleaning as needed, but cleaning and etching have different purposes and cleaning may change film thickness Node names and dry/wet labels are insufficient on their own for selection
